# Digital Security Solutions

> Digital Security Solutions (DSS) is a Delhi-based supplier and installer of
> CCTV cameras, access control, biometric attendance and alarm systems, serving
> homes and businesses across Delhi NCR and India. Tagline: "Surety of Security".
> Established in 2008 (18+ years) with authorised, trusted brands.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Digital Security Solutions (also known as DSS)
- **Website:** https://digitalsecurityindia.com
- **What we do:** Sales, installation, and support of security & surveillance systems
- **Address:** Shop Number-34 & 35, Near Nirman Vihar Metro Station, Vikas Marg, Shakarpur, Delhi-110092, India
- **Phone:** +91 99996 05550
- **Email:** info@digitalsecurityindia.com
- **Service area:** Delhi NCR and pan-India
- **Established:** 2008 (18+ years of experience)
- **Opening hours:** Monday–Sunday, 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM

## Products & services

- CCTV cameras & NVR/DVR surveillance systems
- Access control systems
- Biometric & identity / attendance systems
- Intrusion & burglar alarm systems
- Video door phones & intercoms
- Smart locks & gate automation
- Home automation
- PA systems & professional audio-visual (AV)
- Professional installation, support & maintenance

## Brands we supply

Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, Godrej, Bosch, Honeywell (Impact by Honeywell),
Panasonic, Matrix, Zicom, Seagate, eSSL, PRAMA, Bose Professional, JBL Professional.

## Why choose Digital Security Solutions

- 18+ years of experience in security systems (since 2008)
- Complete, end-to-end security systems
- Trusted, authorised brands and technology
- Professional installation by trained technicians
- Ongoing support & maintenance
